newsitem.title: PERU: Bus crash in Peruvian jungle kills 11 - radio.
newsitem.headline: Bus crash in Peruvian jungle kills 11 - radio.

text.p: A bus overturned in southern Peru's remote jungle highlands killing 11 people and injuring a further 17, local radio reported on Thursday.
The bus was travelling between the cities of Juliaca and Macusani in the department of Puno 800 miles (1,300 km) south of the capital Lima, Radioprogramas said

Puno's Civil Defence chief, Juan Alvarez, said locals had reported the crash by short-wave radio. But he could not confirm the deaths as officials had not reached the site in the isolated zone where the southern Andes merge into the jungle.
